Apartment 6A drainage route: "Show me the drainage from Apartment 6A." resolves through Oyi and keeps the Drainage board open on the real stack-connection chain

Recovery captured — resetting the provider returns the stack connection to NORMAL
All Systems view: the pre-existing integrated engineering layer selection renders every connected operational system together with no errors — confirmed still working after Drainage V1 was added
Structure view: Engineering -> Structure renders the structural layer with no errors

Structural information card: the underlying fix (LunaContextCard.tsx's new structural-element branch) is implemented and type-checked, but no screen-space click in this headless harness reached a structural element behind the (non-fading, clip-is-visual-only) facade — a disclosed, known testing-harness limitation, not evidence the fix is broken.
